answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-work combined with a zero-knowledge trellis structure prevents node proliferation by binding network validation rights to non-transferable computational expenditures. Every participating agent must regularly generate a verifiable sonnet of execution proofs rooted in a cryptographically secured jade ledger state. This forces attackers to scale hardware linearly with identity creation, rendering the cost of deploying millions of fake identities economically prohibitive.
